translation.spanish: Él Mismo es el Benefactor y el Dador de Éxtasis y así como es Su Voluntad así son los seres humanos conducidos.(13)

english.default: He Himself is the Creator, and He Himself is the Enjoyer.

english.default: He Himself is immaculate, compassionate, the lover of nectar; the Hukam of His Command cannot be erased. ||14||

english.default: Those who know the One Lord are very fortunate.
